_about: Legend: Pandora's jar (Hesiod, Works and Days 42-105, c. 700 BC). Jonny 27 Nov 23:33 Berlin picked H1 silent crack + E1 Grandma's candle jar. Our take vs Siren's knocking hook: the evils come SILENTLY (WD 102-104), Hope stays under the rim (WD 96-99). Hero Pandora, her first night (our dramatisation). Speakers N narrator, G grandmother, K kid (off screen voice + ending), P Prometheus, E Epimetheus. Pandora never speaks (Hesiod gives no motive). Subtitles UPPER third word by word, story banner above them, TikTok export without subtitles.

G.style: an old woman in her eighties, warm but stern, low slightly raspy voice, slow and calm

K.style: a twelve-year-old boy from a film, natural child actor, clearly a boy, voice not broken yet, curious and cheeky, speaks clearly with crisp diction

P.style: a grown man in his forties, hoarse and urgent, a warning between brothers, no accent imitation

E.style: a big friendly man in his thirties, booming, cheerful, a bit slow, no accent imitation

lines: The most dangerous gift in history... made no sound.
low, slow, close to the mic; over the jar lid open a crack in total silence (frame 0)
whisper, off screen, scared and curious
Brother. Never take a gift from Zeus. Never.
urgent, hoarse, gripping his brother's arm; Prometheus
He had just stolen fire from the gods. For us. And Zeus... laughed out loud.
Then he ordered a gift humans would love... right up to the end.
The smith god mixed mud and water into a woman. And every god gave her something.
A dress. A smile. And from Hermes... a liar's tongue.
each gift a beat, last one sly
They called her Pandora. All-gifted. And one gift was a trap.
RE-HOOK 2 at ~20 s, last sentence low
Hermes walked her to the door of the other brother.
Her first night in the house. In the corner stood a jar, taller than a man. Sealed.
And here's the strangest part. Nobody ever wrote down WHY she did it.
No crash. No scream. Not a sound.
whisper, music cut to nothing; the lid lifts
Out came sickness. Hard work. Old age. Before that night, people had none of them.
Zeus had taken their voices. So they still come for you... without a sound.
She slammed the lid. But one thing didn't make it out.
fast then hushed, RE-HOOK 4 at ~58 s
Under the rim, one tiny light. Hope.
Two thousand seven hundred years... and nobody agrees.
flat, firm, right after her hand slaps the lid shut; cut out after 'in'
